guaranteedRewards.name: Symbol of Life
tooltip: Use: The Symbol of Life will bring the person attuned to it back to life.

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Make haste, adventurer, more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail.

If for some reason you fail to help Gazin and Henze, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels.

Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other Champion and continual failure may reflect upon you later.
